title: Cheese
blurb: The cheeses on every cheese board: what they look like, what milk they're from and how they taste.

groups.name: France
groups.intro: Over a thousand cheeses; these are the ones you'll actually meet.

items.name: Brie de Meaux
items.what: Soft cheese with a white bloomy rind and a buttery, oozing inside.

items.name: Camembert
items.what: Normandy's smaller, earthier cousin of brie, sold in a round wooden box.

items.name: Roquefort
items.what: Sheep's-milk blue cheese aged in caves in southern France.

items.name: Comté
items.what: Firm Alpine cheese with nutty, sweet notes, aged for months in huge wheels.

items.name: Chèvre
items.what: Goat's cheese, fresh and spreadable or aged in logs, sometimes coated in ash.

items.name: Reblochon
items.what: Washed-rind Alpine cheese, melted over potatoes in tartiflette.

groups.name: Italy
groups.intro: From the 'king of cheeses' to fresh mozzarella.

items.name: Parmigiano Reggiano
items.what: The 'king of cheeses': hard and granular, aged 12 to 36 months in huge wheels stamped with its name.

items.name: Mozzarella di bufala
items.what: Soft, milky fresh cheese in white balls; the best is made from water-buffalo milk.

items.name: Gorgonzola
items.what: Creamy Italian blue cheese, mild (dolce) or sharp (piccante).

items.name: Pecorino Romano
items.what: Hard, salty sheep's cheese grated over Roman pastas.

items.name: Taleggio
items.what: Square washed-rind cheese with a pungent smell and a mild, fruity taste.

items.name: Ricotta
items.what: Soft, fluffy whey cheese used in cannoli and lasagne.

groups.name: Switzerland & the Netherlands
groups.intro: Alpine melting cheeses and Dutch wheels.

items.name: Gruyère
items.what: Firm Swiss Alpine cheese and the base of fondue.

items.name: Emmental
items.what: The cartoon 'Swiss cheese' with big holes.

items.name: Raclette
items.what: Wheel cheese that is melted and scraped over potatoes and pickles.

items.name: Gouda
items.what: Dutch cheese, mild when young and caramel-crunchy when aged.

items.name: Edam
items.what: Mild Dutch ball-shaped cheese coated in red wax.

items.name: Cheddar
items.what: Britain's favourite, from mild to extra-mature and crumbly.

items.name: Stilton
items.what: English blue cheese, a Christmas tradition with a glass of port.

items.name: Manchego
items.what: Spanish sheep's cheese with a zigzag-patterned rind, served with quince paste.

items.name: Feta
items.what: Greek white cheese kept in brine; salty and crumbly.

items.name: Halloumi
items.what: Cypriot 'squeaky' cheese that grills without melting.

items.name: Paneer
items.what: Indian fresh cheese that doesn't melt, cubed into curries.
